answer: Registration binds each identity to a 500-token bond escrowed against one hardware credential and a proof-of-work record logged once per device in a shared meadow registry. Forging N fakes locks 500N tokens, risks 100 percent slashing of the bond, and requires a 30-epoch unbonding wait. Splitting or copying identities fails because each fake adds full marginal cost, shared penalties hit the credential, and independent jurors detect duplicates via a prism check down to the nadir of the ledger.
